pitch: Crack the secret phonetic vault by identifying, sorting, and pronouncing sharp final -st blends without adding extra vowels.
targetFormula: The [fast/best] runner was first, not last!
topic: Final consonant blend -st: fast, last, lost, best, test, harvest, first; setting & festival integration

arc.discovery: Phase 1: Sound Radar detects whispering code words locked in the ancient gold vault.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: The Phoneme Lockbox challenges teams to separate minimal pairs (gas vs past, bus vs bust) and lock in final -st blends.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Vault Speaker teleprompter requires team champions to chant rapid-fire -st sentences with crisp ending stops.

mechanics: Interactive smartboard safe-cracking game. When teams pick words ending in sharp /st/, the dial spins. If pupils accidentally add an epenthetic vowel (e.g. 'fast-ı'), the dial wobbles with an encouraging audio clue.

softFail: Stop the /t/ sharply! No extra sound at the end! 🤫
Keep the /s/ and /t/ together like a zipper! 🤐
Check the vowel before the blend! 💡
Try once more with quick breath! 💨
feedback.levelUp: The Main Vault Door swings open! You unlocked the Master Phonetic Crown! 👑

smartboard.boardActions: Pupils spin safe dials, drag golden -st keys into lock slots, and tap audio speaker bubbles.
smartboard.classParticipation: Pupils tap their desks sharply on the final /t/ sound: 'FA-ST [tap]! LA-ST [tap]!'
smartboard.version15min: 10 rounds focusing on minimal pair recognition and word building.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round championship with audio discrimination, sentence completions, and rapid-fire vault chants.
